descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 7 8700F 8-Core 16-Thread Desktop Processor (Socket AM5 / 4.1GHz Base Clock / Up to 5.0GHz Max Boost / 16MB L3 Cache / 65W TDP / Zen 4 Architecture / TSMC 4nm FinFET / PCIe 4.0 Support / DDR5 Memory / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Take your gaming and content creation performance to the next level with the AMD Ryzen 7 8700F desktop processor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a 1-Year store warranty. Built on the advanced Zen 4 architecture using cutting-edge TSMC 4nm process technology (formerly codenamed Phoenix), this Socket AM5 processor features 8 cores and 16 threads with boost speeds reaching up to 5.0GHz. Operating efficiently at a default 65W TDP (cTDP 45-65W), it fully supports high-performance DDR5 memory and PCIe 4.0 connectivity, making it an ideal core component for high-end desktop gaming builds.
